synopsis: Chapter 8 lists the Volvo A60 articulated hauler at about 96,562 lb (44 t) empty and 217,706 lb (99 t) gross, with a payload of 60.6 short tons (55 t) [f5961]. The glossary consistently repeats the approximately 44 t empty and 99 t loaded or gross masses [f11371, f11414, f13616]. These figures are manufacturer specifications, not measured performance results, so they establish a mass reference rather than evidence of braking performance [f5964].
